name: viggle-studio-root
description: Root helper for the Viggle Studio monorepo: server/ (Node backend) and viggle-studio/ (Ionic Angular app).

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix viggle-studio
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix viggle-studio
scripts.android:sync: npm run build --prefix viggle-studio && npx --prefix viggle-studio cap sync android
scripts.build: npm run server:build && npm run app:build
